phase: Luna — True Floor Plan System V1: L06 Gold Standard Architectural Floor
successCondition: Level 6 becomes one real digital floor: canonical data + 2D plan + 3D architecture + navigation + transitions + policy + Oyi all agree. Proof journey: Exterior -> real Grand Lobby -> real Lift -> Level 6 -> real L06 Lift Lobby -> Apartment A entrance.

after.note: 2D plan now reads the exact LUNA_L06_UNITS entry the 3D massing box uses

floorPlate.disclosedAsymmetry: Both real protected stairs sit on the same (north) side of the building (fixed, building-wide LUNA_CORES constraint) — Apartments A/B reach both stairs via the Lift Lobby, not a direct spur.
floorPlate.disclosedSimplification: The Lift Lobby is one open circulation volume containing all 3 passenger lifts + the service/fire lift + the riser — no separate walled service landing (insufficient real depth: 3.4m).

programmeCorrection.before: every L06 unit hardcoded to 2 bedrooms regardless of tier
programmeCorrection.scope: L06 only — every other generated standard level (L02-L05, L07-L09) keeps its disclosed-as-reference uniform 2-bedroom default

doorAnimationDisclosure: All 4 doors render CLOSED with no live open/close runtime binding — STATIC_BOUNDARY, matching the Ground stair doors' own honest category. Real ACCESS_CONTROLLED resolution and real camera crossing do not require an animating leaf mesh.
realBugsFoundAndFixed: lunaRepresentationPolicy.ts's resolveLevelRefFor() crashed for any ref with no InteriorSpec (a private unit or the new Lift Lobby) — fixed with a real 'unit' branch; 3 dependent test-canary hashes updated with disclosed reasoning
LunaRouteDriver.tsx's MOVE step never called onCurrentSpaceChange, silently completing without reporting a real destination change — a generic route-engine bug, fixed generically (not Luna-specific)

A JSX prop named 'ref' in a new component (L06CommonArchitecture.tsx) silently broke click-select/hover on the new circulation zones — caught by oxlint, renamed to 'ref_' matching the codebase's own convention
testUpdatesDisclosed: verifyIngestionV2.mjs: deriveFloorPlanSpec() bit-for-bit equivalence updated — the hand-authored plan now layers real core/circulation enrichments the generic model doesn't yet derive as units; outline check changed from equality to containment-within-envelope
verifyL06GoldStandard.mjs: plan/massing divergence assertion (from the prior Architectural Reality V2 phase) updated to assert convergence, since this phase resolved that exact divergence

navigationGraph.freeAdjacencyEdge: LUNA-L06 (level) <-> LUNA-L06-LOBBY (common area), via the generic 'common areas get a free adjacency edge to their own level' engine rule
navigationGraph.liftArrivalFix: App.tsx's LEVEL_ARRIVAL_REF map redirects a physical route to LUNA-L06 toward LUNA-L06-LOBBY instead — LevelRail's own instant LOCATE click is unaffected

policy.routeEdgePredicateTightened: lunaRoutePolicy.ts now requires FULL_3D specifically (not just spatially-visible) before a route may cross into a private unit's real door
policy.facilityResult: OK — can route into any apartment, including B/C/D (Facility-owned building context)
policy.consumerResult: a resident of Apartment A can route into Apartment A only; B/C/D routes are excluded before any door-crossing narration

workingPhrasesProven: Take me back to the ground floor
oyi.disclosedPreExistingLimitation: "Where is X?" phrasing is intercepted by an earlier matcher (matchQuery) before it reaches space resolution, returning 'unknown' — confirmed against 'Where is Stair 1?' and 'Where is Apartment A?' too, not introduced by this phase. 'Show me X' is the real working equivalent.

explicitlyDeferred: Apartment B/C/D interior rooms, furniture, MEP (real shell envelopes only — Part 11's own scope boundary)
